theater: 晉南河東絳州龍門一帶

battle.name: 李淵剿撫汾晉起義軍
battle.theater: 晉南河東絳州龍門一帶
battle.brief: 大業十一年四月，隋煬帝避暑汾陽宮，以衛尉少卿李淵為山西河東撫慰大使，發河東兵討捕群盜。李淵行至龍門，擊賤帥母端兒破之；十二月奉詔代樊子蓋討絳賊敬盤陀，改焚殺為招撫，賊眾多降數萬人。連弩是城頭壓制與追剿的制式器械。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰一方是隋朝官軍，兵分三路來源：河東兵，即李淵以山西、河東撫慰大使身份調發的州郡鄉兵與屯田戍卒；關中兵，即民部尚書樊子蓋奉詔帶領的關內討捕軍，數萬之眾；以及郡縣守令各自徵發的鄉兵與州鎮兵。李淵出鎮時還握有一項授權：可以承製黶陟、選補郡縣文武官，這是撫慰使與討捕使合一的地方大員權柄。另一方是河東、絳州一帶的群盜與叛眾：賤帥母端兒據龍門一帶，絳賊敬盤陀等據絳州與汾水兩岸，另有被官軍焚村塢、坑殺降者之後新聚的百姓，眾至數萬，多無常備編制，只推首領行事，以村塢、山寨為依託，備刀矛、勁弓與簡陋的雲梯、檑木，攻城能力有限。同一時間北方有突厥騎兵逼近雁門，關中、江南、淮南亦有群盜起事，山西遂成官軍、叛眾與外敵三方交錯之地。
countriesEn: The government side was the Sui field force, and its men came from three sources. The first was the Hedong troops, that is the county militia and the settlement-farm soldiers that Li Yuan levied in his capacity as Commissioner for Pacification and Relief of Shanxi and Hedong. The second was the Guanzhong troops, that is the army with which the Minister of Revenue Fan Zigan was sent, several tens of thousands of men, to deal with the Jian bandits. The third was the village militia and the garrison troops of the prefectures and lesser posts, raised locally by the commandery and county officers. Li Yuan also went out holding a special warrant: the right to decide promotions, demotions and appointments in the civil and military posts of the commanderies and counties, which made him a provincial great officer holding the pacifying and the suppressing commission in one person. The other side was the bands of brigands and rebels in Hedong and around Jiangzhou. The low-born commander Mu Duan'er held the ground around Longmen; the Jian bandits under Jing Pantuo and others held Jiangzhou and both banks of the Fen river; and there were fresh bands of villagers who had gathered only after the officials burned their villages and buried the men who surrendered. These groups could run to tens of thousands, and none of them had a standing establishment: they obeyed only the chiefs they had raised themselves, held stockades and hill fastings, and carried knives, spears, strong bows and crude ladders and battering logs, with little power to lay siege. At the same moment Turkic horse closed on Yanmen in the north, and there were risings in Guanzhong, in Jiangnan and in Huainan, so that Shanxi became a crossroads where the court, the rebels and the outer enemy all met.
people: 關鍵人物首推李淵。時任衛尉少卿，四月奉詔為山西、河東撫慰大使，承製黶陟選補郡縣文武官，發河東兵討捕群盜，行至龍門擊賤帥母端兒破之；十二月又奉詔代樊子蓋討絳賊。他此前已代為弘化郡留守，關右十三郡兵皆受其徵發，《資治通鑑》稱他御眾寬簡、人多附之，而隋煬帝因他相表奇異、又名應圖讖而忌之。次為隋煬帝楊廣，其時巡行塞北，七月突厥始畢可汗帥騎數十萬謀襲乘輿，車駕馳入雁門，齊王暕以後軍保崞縣，城中兵民十五萬口而食僅可支二旬；義成公主先遣使者告變，其後又為隋廷轉求於突厥，與各郡援軍同時抵達，雁門之圍乃解。地方上，母端兒、敬盤陀是起義一方的首領，樊子蓋以不分臮否、焚村塢、坑降者著稱；馬邑太守王仁恭與雁門郡丞陳孝意則是官軍一方的邊將。李淵次子世民年方十六，亦應募隸屯衛將軍雲定興，以白晝引旌旗數十里、夜間鉦鼓相應的疑兵之計，助雁門解圍。
peopleEn: The central figure is Li Yuan. He was then Vice Commandant of the Guards, and in the fourth month was appointed Commissioner for Pacification and Relief of Shanxi and Hedong, with the right to decide promotions, demotions and appointments in the civil and military posts of the commanderies and counties; he levied the Hedong troops to hunt down the brigands, marched as far as Longmen and defeated and broke the low-born commander Mu Duan'er; and in the twelfth month he was ordered to take over from Fan Zigan the campaign against the Jian bandits. He had earlier stood in for the governor of Honghua, and the troops of the thirteen commanderies of the Right were all mustered under him; the Zizhi Tongjian says of him that he commanded his men with easy informality and that many attached themselves to him, while Emperor Yang was wary of him because of his strange physiognomy and because the name he answered to was held to answer a prophecy. Next comes Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, then touring the northern frontier: in the seventh month the Turkic qaghan Shibi led tens of thousands of riders against the imperial carriage, the court fled into Yanmen and Prince Qi Jiong held Heng County with the rearguard, while the city held a hundred and fifty thousand soldiers and people whose food would last only twenty days; the wise princess Yicheng first sent word of the danger, and later carried the court's appeal to the Turks, and with the relieving troops from the various commanderies the siege of Yanmen was lifted. On the local side, Mu Duan'er and Jing Pantuo were the chiefs of the insurgents, while Fan Zigan was notorious for sparing nobody, burning the villages and burying those who surrendered; Wang Rengong, governor of Mayi, and Chen Xiaoyi, commandant of Yanmen, were the court's own frontier officers. Li Yuan's second son, Shimin, was only sixteen that year; he too enrolled as a volunteer under the Colonel of the Garrison, Yun Dingxing, and helped relieve Yanmen by a feint in which banners were paraded for tens of li by day and gongs and drums beaten by night, to make the enemy believe a great relief army had arrived.
kits: 卡面這具秦連弩是弩機連發的制式器械：以踏板與槓桿把弩弦的拉力預先儲存，取用時一踩一發，箭矢由矢匣連續送出，有效射程約百步至百五十步；其形制見於戰國至秦的銅弩機，出土於關中與楚地墓葬，隋代仍是弩類器械中射速最高的一種。守城時可把連弩分作數段配置於城頭，交叉覆蓋城門、馬道、雲梯接近點與牆根，把攻城者壓在牆外；野戰則以弩陣前出，射一陣而退，掩護步兵結陣推進。其短處是連發之後須整具重新上弦，精度不及單發的蹶張弩、機弩，一次齊射便耗去數十支箭，因此只在城頭掩體之後或弩陣前出時密集使用。與之並用的是蹶張弩、機弩等單發重弩，專射城門、射樓與密集隊形；攻防兩端另有雲梯、檑木、撞車、投石機、飛樓，與拒馬、鹿角、陷坑，野戰配槊、刀、盾，並備輜重車運糧秣、鼓號旗幟以傳號令。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card is a standard weapon that stores the draw of the bowstring: a treadle and lever hold the tension in advance, and each time the operator stamps the pedal one bolt is released, the shafts running out of the magazine in sequence, with a useful range of roughly one hundred to one hundred and fifty paces. Its form is known from the bronze crossbow triggers of the Warring States and Qin periods excavated from tombs in the Guanzhong and Chu regions, and in Sui times it remained the fastest-firing member of the crossbow family. In defence it can be broken into several sections posted along the ramparts, its cross-fire covering the gates, the ramp approaches, the points where the ladders were set and the foot of the wall, so that the attackers are pinned outside; in the field a crossbow line advances ahead of the formation, looses a volley and withdraws, covering the infantry as it closes up. Its drawbacks are that the whole mechanism must be re-cocked after a volley, that its accuracy is below that of the single-shot zuzhang and ji crossbows, and that it burns shafts fast, one volley costing dozens of arrows, so it was used in mass only from behind cover on the walls or when a line came forward to shoot. Alongside it stood single-shot heavy crossbows such as the zuzhang and the ji crossbow, kept for the gates, the shooting towers and massed formations. The rest of the equipment for attack and defence included scaling ladders, battering logs, rams, traction trebuchets and flying towers on the attacking side, and chevaux-de-frise, antler barriers and pits on the defending side; in the field the troops carried spears, sabres and shields, and the column had baggage wagons for grain and drums, horns and banners for signalling.
tactics: 此役的處置以剿撫並用為綱，而撫在先、剿在後。撫的一面是給官與給糧：四月李淵以撫慰大使兼討捕使出發，承製黶陟、選補郡縣文武官，用官職與選補換取地方吏員的合作，並以屯田與軍糧維持州縣運作；剿的一面是出兵：發河東兵討捕群盜，行至龍門擊賤帥母端兒破之，又分道追剿、斷其糧道、驅其入山澤。十二月代樊子蓋之後，政策為之一變：樊子蓋不分臮否，自汾水之北把村塢盡焚，賊有降者皆坑之，百姓怨憤而益相聚為盜；李淵反其道而行，有降者即引置左右，收編為屯田與郡兵，賊眾因是多降，前後數萬人，餘黨散入它郡。城防上以連弩分段落列於城頭，配合拒馬、鹿角與陷坑設於城門內側，並以信騎與烽火通消息，確保援軍與糧運及時抵達。李淵在太原素以御眾寬簡得人心，剿中寓撫，遂成此役取勝之要。
tacticsEn: The handling of the rising turned on the two words punish and pacify used together, with pacification in front and punishment behind. Pacification meant giving posts and giving grain: in the fourth month Li Yuan set out as pacifying commissioner and bandit-suppressor in one, empowered to decide promotions, demotions and appointments in the civil and military posts of the commanderies and counties, trading offices and appointments for the cooperation of the local officers, and keeping the counties running with the settlement farms and the military grain. Punishment meant sending troops: the Hedong levies went out to hunt the brigands, Li Yuan marched as far as Longmen and broke the low-born commander Mu Duan'er, and the columns went out by separate roads to cut the bands off from their food and drive them into the hills. When he took over from Fan Zigan in the twelfth month the policy was reversed. Fan Zigan had spared nobody, burned every village north of the Fen and buried the men who surrendered, so that the people were furious and gathered as bandits in greater numbers. Li Yuan ran the opposite way: those who surrendered were brought in and placed at his side, enrolled in the settlement farms and the commandery militia, and because of this the bandits came over in large numbers, several tens of thousands in all, while the remnants scattered into the neighbouring commanderies. On the defensive side the repeating crossbows were broken into sections along the ramparts, with chevaux-de-frise, antler barriers and pits set inside the gates, and couriers and beacon fires carried the news so that reinforcements and grain would arrive in time. Li Yuan had always been noted at Taiyuan for the easy informality with which he handled his men, and punishment wrapped around pacification was the key to his success in this campaign.
data: 此役的兵員與糧秣，在《資治通鑑》卷一百八十二中多以約數記之，可核者如下：隋煬帝七月被圍雁門，城中兵民十五萬口，食僅可支二旬；雁門四十一城，突厥克其三十九，唯雁門、崞不下；始畢可汗出騎數十萬。樊子蓋奉詔發關中兵數萬擊絳賊。李淵招撫所得，賊眾多降，前後數萬人，餘黨散入它郡。兵制上的參照數字：關右十三郡兵在李淵任留守時皆受其徵發；十六年（616）李淵與馬邑太守王仁恭擊突厥，兩軍眾不滿五千，淵獨選善騎射者二千人；十七年（617）正月李淵以右驍衛將軍唐公領太原留守，討甄翟兒於雀鼠谷，眾才數千。行程上，晉陽至龍門（河津）約二百餘里，汾水自北而南流貫晉南，順流而下數日可達。軍械方面，弓弩是州縣守具中最耗用者，連弩齊射一次便以數十支箭計，攻城與野戰的總耗當以萬計。
dataEn: The numbers of men and stores for this campaign are given in the Zizhi Tongjian, volume 182, mostly in round figures, and the following can be checked. In the seventh month Emperor Yang was shut up in Yanmen: the city held a hundred and fifty thousand soldiers and people with food for twenty days only; of the forty-one commandery cities of Yanmen the Turks took thirty-nine, and only Yanmen and Heng did not fall; Shibi led tens of thousands of riders. Fan Zigan was sent with several tens of thousands of Guanzhong troops against the Jian bandits. Under Li Yuan the bands came over in large numbers, several tens of thousands in all, and the remnants scattered into the neighbouring commanderies. For the order of battle the comparison figures are these: the troops of the thirteen commanderies of the Right were all mustered under Li Yuan while he was the garrison commander; in 616 Li Yuan and Wang Rengong, governor of Mayi, took the field against the Turks with fewer than five thousand men between them, Li Yuan choosing two thousand of the best riders and archers; in the first month of 617 Li Yuan, as Right Flying Guard general and the Tang duke, took up the post of garrison commander of Taiyuan and fought Zhen Zhaier at Queshu Valley with a force of only some thousands. In distances, it is about two hundred li from Jinyang to Longmen, that is Hejin; the Fen river runs north to south through southern Shanxi and can be floated down in a matter of days. In stores, the crossbows were the most wasteful item in a commandery's defence, a single volley costing dozens of shafts, and the total expenditure of the siege and the field operations must have run to tens of thousands of arrows.
cause: 起義的根由不在一事，而在隋朝晚期同時發作的幾道裂痕。其一是役與兵：開皇末以來三征高句麗，役夫死者猶太半不返，天下疲敝，州縣的丁口大量淪為逃戶與逃丁。其二是財與役：營建東都、洛陽、開鑿渠道與漕運，徭役暴增，北運的糧船常為沿途官吏截留，百姓既失其業又失其時。其三是天災：北旱南澇、蝗災相仍，糧價騰貴，晉南汾水兩岸的村塢多已無餘糧可出。其四是官府逼反：州縣為完成上計而括戶括丁，討捕使樊子蓋又不分臮否，焚村塢、坑降者，把本可招撫的鄉民一律推去為盜，《資治通鑑》遂記百姓怨憤、益相聚為盜。其五是兵力配置：隋煬帝把主力帶往塞北與遼東，山西只剩撫慰使的區區兵力，一旦叛眾席捲州縣，郡兵數日即告瓦解。於是河東、絳州一帶的群盜，由零星劫掠發展成能攻守州郡的成股力量。
causeEn: The roots of the rising lay not in a single grievance but in several cracks that opened in the Sui at the same time. The first was labour and military service: with the three campaigns against Goguryeo since the end of the Kaihuang era, so many of the corvee never came back that the realm was exhausted, and the households of the commanderies and counties turned in great numbers into runaways and absent conscripts. The second was money and labour again: the building of the eastern capital and Luoyang, the cutting of canals and the grain transport multiplied the forced labour, and the grain barges running north were constantly detained by officials along the route, so the people lost both their trade and their season. The third was weather: drought in the north, flooding in the south and locusts came together, prices of grain rose out of all reason, and the villages along the Fen in southern Shanxi had nothing left to give. The fourth was the pressure of the administration: the commanderies and counties rounded up households and pressed men into service to meet the quotas reported upward, and the bandit-suppressor Fan Zigan spared nobody, burning the villages and burying the surrendered, driving into brigandage country folk who might otherwise have been pacified; hence the Tongjian's line that the people were furious and so gathered as bandits in greater numbers. The fifth was the distribution of troops: Emperor Yang had taken the bulk of the field army to the northern frontier and to Liaodong, leaving in Shanxi only the small forces of a pacifying commissioner, and once the rebels swept over the commandery seats the county troops dissolved within days. Thus the bands in Hedong and around Jiangzhou grew from scattered plunder into organised bodies able to attack and defend the walled seats of commanderies.
impact: 此役的直接效果是河東、絳州一帶的州郡治所復歸官府，被擄的州縣吏員與被掠的器物得以回錄，降眾被編入屯田與郡兵，汾水流域的漕運與屯田重新運作，晉陽到河東的軍糧線恢復暢通，隋朝在山西的統治得以維持。更重要的後果卻落在李淵身上：他以區區河東兵平了群盜，又以招撫收得數萬降眾，兵不血刃而名聲大著，御眾寬簡、人多附之的聲望替他聚起人望，太原道兵的規模與裝備都在這幾年裡成形，兩年後晉陽起兵的物資與兵源便由此而來；同時他一人兼任撫慰使與討捕使，能黶陟選補郡縣官吏，中央對山西的直接控制反而更弱，地方軍頭的權柄更重。更深一層的隱患是餘黨散入它郡：散兵並未消滅，只是換了地方。兩年後（617）劉武周在馬邑起事，眾至數十萬，突厥立之為定楊可汗，其軍破樓煩、取汾陽宮、進圍雁門，山西再度陷入兵禍，李淵未竟的安太原之業，只能在關中另起根基才能完成。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the campaign was that the seats of the commanderies in Hedong and around Jiangzhou returned to government hands; the officials who had been carried off and the goods that had been plundered were recovered and recorded; the surrendered were enrolled in the settlement farms and the commandery militia; the transport route and the settlement farms along the Fen began to run again; the grain line from Jinyang into Hedong was restored, and Sui rule in Shanxi was kept on its feet. The more important consequences, however, fell on Li Yuan. He had put down the bands with a handful of Hedong troops and had taken in tens of thousands of surrendered men by the policy of pacification, winning a great name without shedding much blood; the reputation for easy informality that drew men to him gathered a new following, and the size and equipment of the Taiyuan circuit troops took shape in these same years, so that the material base and the manpower for the uprising in Jinyang two years later grew out of them. At the same time, holding the pacifying and the suppressing commission in one person and having the right to promote, demote and appoint the officers of the commanderies and counties, he made the central government's direct control of Shanxi weaker and the power of the local warlord heavier. The deeper hidden danger lay in the remnants scattering into the neighbouring commanderies: the broken bands were not destroyed, only relocated. Two years later, in 617, Liu Wuzhou rose at Mayi with tens of thousands of men, the Turks made him qaghan of Dingyang, his forces took Loulan and the Fenyang Palace and closed on Yanmen, and Shanxi was once more dragged into war; the work of settling Taiyuan that Li Yuan had begun could only be finished by making a fresh start in Guanzhong.
result: 結果有明文可稽：四月李淵行至龍門，擊賤帥母端兒破之；十二月詔以李淵代樊子蓋討絳賊敬盤陀等，改以招撫為主，有降者淵引置左右，由是賊眾多降，前後數萬人，餘黨散入它郡，汾晉之間的戰事至此收束。官府隨即重配汾、晉二州的刺史與縣吏，罷樊子蓋的焚殺之政，州縣的屯田與編戶復舊。李淵則以功加賞，在山西的權柄愈重，山西的兵源、馬匹與糧秣皆由他調度，隨後數年他招兵練兵、置屯蓄馬，把北都經營成一座不亞於關中的兵源基地；至於傳世文獻所稱此後授其尚書令之職，《資治通鑑》於本役之後未載其詳，姑存其說而不敢深信。但亂源並未因此清除：兩年後（617）劉武周自馬邑起兵，眾至數十萬，突厥立之為定楊可汗，其軍破樓煩、進取汾陽宮、進圍雁門，晉陽危殆；李淵終於以右驍衛將軍唐公領太原留守起兵，山西之亂至此才由剿撫換成另一種解決方式。
resultEn: The outcome is set down in the record. In the fourth month Li Yuan marched to Longmen and defeated the low-born commander Mu Duan'er, breaking his band. In the twelfth month the court ordered Li Yuan to take over from Fan Zigan against the Jian bandits under Jing Pantuo and the rest, and he changed the method to pacification; those who surrendered were brought in and placed at his side, and because of this the bandits came over in numbers, several tens of thousands in all, while the remnants scattered into the neighbouring commanderies, and the fighting in Fen and Jin came to an end there. The government then reappointed the governors and magistrates of the two prefectures, abandoned Fan Zigan's policy of burning and killing, and the settlement farms and the household registers of the commanderies were put back on their old footing. Li Yuan was rewarded for his service and grew heavier in his authority over Shanxi; the manpower, the horses and the grain of Shanxi were all moved at his word, and for the next several years he raised and drilled troops, opened settlement farms and bred horses, turning the Northern Capital into a base for manpower no inferior to the one he would build in Guanzhong. As for the claim in the transmitted histories that he was presently given the post of Shangshu Ling, the Zizhi Tongjian does not give the details of the appointment after this campaign, so the statement may be noted but not pressed. The disorder itself was not over. Two years later, in 617, Liu Wuzhou rose at Mayi with tens of thousands of men; the Turks made him qaghan of Dingyang; his forces took Loulan, seized the Fenyang Palace and closed on Yanmen, and Jinyang was in danger. Li Yuan at last rose in arms as Right Flying Guard general and the Tang duke, taking up the post of garrison commander of Taiyuan, and the disorder of Shanxi was from then on met by something other than punishment and pacification.
